Refund Policy

Last updated: [Month Day, Year]

We want you to love what you wear from Zephyr Archive. If something isn’t right, here is how returns, exchanges, and refunds work.

Returns

You can return items within 30 days of delivery for a refund. To be eligible, items must be unworn, unwashed, and in the same condition you received them, with any original tags and packaging.

We can’t accept returns of items that have been worn, washed, altered, or damaged after delivery, or items marked final sale.

Exchanges

Want a different item instead? Contact us within 30 days of delivery and we’ll help you exchange it, as long as the item you want is in stock. If it isn’t, we’ll refund your return instead.

How to start a return or exchange

  1. Email us at support@zephyrarchive.com with your order number and the item you’d like to return or exchange.
  2. We’ll reply with the return address and instructions. Items sent back without contacting us first may not be accepted.
  3. Pack the item securely and send it back. We recommend a trackable shipping method; we can’t be responsible for returns lost in transit.

Return shipping

For regular returns and exchanges, you cover the cost of shipping the item back to us, and original shipping charges are not refunded. If we made a mistake or the item arrived damaged or defective, we’ll cover return shipping.

Refunds

Once your return arrives, we’ll inspect it and email you to let you know whether it’s approved. Approved refunds go back to your original payment method within 5–10 business days. Your bank or card issuer may take a few extra days to post it.

Damaged, defective, or wrong items

Please check your order when it arrives. If anything is damaged, defective, or not what you ordered, email us within 14 days of delivery with your order number and a photo, and we’ll make it right with a replacement or a full refund, including shipping.

Cancellations

Need to cancel? Contact us as soon as possible. If your order hasn’t shipped yet, we’ll cancel it and refund you in full. Once an order has shipped, it can be returned under this policy instead.

Missing a refund?

If you haven’t received an approved refund after 10 business days, first check with your bank or card issuer, since processing can take time. If you still don’t see it, contact us and we’ll look into it.

Contact us

Questions about returns, exchanges, or refunds can be sent to:

Zephyr Archive LLC
Email: support@zephyrarchive.com
